topic.title: How to Change the Font of MathML Equations

indexterm.product: author developer editor authorEclipse developerEclipse editorEclipse

body.p: If you want to change the font used for MathML equations in your documentation, regardless if the equations are wrapped in equation-block or equation-inline elements or not, you can target them by using the default mathml-d/mathml class or the equation-d/equation-block and equation-d/equation-inline classes:
body.note: A MathML equation can use multiple font classes, such as serif, sans serif, monospace, fraktur, and doublestruck. Depending on the symbols used in the equation, a particular class is selected. The font specified in the CSS rule, as in the preceding example, applies only to the serif class. If a symbol code point is not available in the selected class font, rendering falls back to the font specified in the CSS rule.
Some fonts might not be supported. In such cases, a default serif font is used.
